ranked.headline: Learned biomolecular models are being tested for binding, design, and kinetic prediction
ranked.summary: Recent preprints pair generative and learned scoring models with stricter tests of epitope conditioning, mutational effects, and kinetic relevance.

ranked.headline: Sequence-level assays reveal context-dependent outcomes in engineered biomolecules
ranked.summary: Deep sequencing, covariation models, and generative ML now resolve function variant by variant across AAV, riboswitch, Cas9, and base-editor systems.

ranked.headline: Steering generative biological models with preferences, rewards, and uncertainty
ranked.summary: Recent preprints shape generative molecule, antibody, and protein models with pairwise preferences, RL, sparse features, and calibrated uncertainty.

ranked.headline: Population geometry and drift statistics serve as tests of neural mechanisms
ranked.summary: Explicit circuit, plasticity, and geometric mechanisms are now evaluated against the internal structure of neural dynamics.

ranked.headline: Multi-input models decode chromatin states, enhancers, and methylation across cell types
ranked.summary: Integrative models combining methylation, histone marks, and sequence now scale to 1,698 IHEC epigenomes and single-cell ATAC-seq data.

ranked.headline: Learned models generate protein conformational ensembles, now checked against simulation
ranked.summary: Learned and coarse-grained models now produce protein ensembles that are being tested against explicit MD and multi-state benchmarks.

ranked.headline: Deep learning models for peptide sequencing and T-cell response prediction in proteomics
ranked.summary: Benchmarking and shortcut-learning audits now accompany deep models for peptide identification and immunogenicity prediction.

ranked.headline: Learned molecular representations reused for property and binding affinity prediction
ranked.summary: Property and affinity models increasingly build on distilled foundation models, contrastive pretraining, and curvature-based geometric encodings of binding…

ranked.headline: Coupling LLMs to domain analytics for biomedical hypothesis and biomarker tasks
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and publications pair language models and machine learning with statistical scoring, retrieval, and interpretable analysis across biomedical…

ranked.headline: Auxiliary priors and covariates constrain gene network inference from expression data
ranked.summary: Recent 2026 preprints and publications pair expression data with regulatory priors, covariates, or biophysical constraints to constrain network inference.

ranked.headline: Deep models encode regulatory and spatial relations to infer cell-state dynamics
ranked.summary: Explicit gene-regulatory, spatial-neighborhood and kinetic priors are being built directly into single-cell and spatial deep learning models.

ranked.headline: Cortical topography imposed as a training objective in brain-representation models
ranked.summary: June 2026 preprints pair cortical topographic structure with foundation, recurrent, and generative models of brain activity.

ranked.headline: Benchmarks and calibrated models for cancer genomics and drug-response prediction
ranked.summary: Externally anchored ground truth, from synthetic tumour evolution to leakage-audited cohorts, is needed to judge cancer prediction and genomics methods.

ranked.headline: Bias-aware models address technical distortion in sequence-derived measurements
ranked.summary: Sequence-derived measurements carry technical biases that ML and explicit bias-modeling methods now target before or during analysis.

ranked.headline: Sequence models extend regulatory and splicing prediction to personal genomes
ranked.summary: Sequence models trained on 22.5M MeRIP-seq regions, airway RNA and personal genomes now target regulatory and splicing outcomes.

ranked.headline: Explicit probabilistic modeling applied to genomic and proteomic inference problems
ranked.summary: Recent work pairs Bayesian and spline-based models with explicit uncertainty, spatial context, or dataset structure in genomic and proteomic prediction.

ranked.headline: Computational methods assign cell identity and audit quality in single-cell data
ranked.summary: Integrated atlases and new annotation and QC tools now scale cell-type assignment across human islets, reproductive tissues, and zebrafish.

ranked.headline: Benchmarking computational methods for biomolecular binding, aggregation, and MD
ranked.summary: LiPP compares co-folding and docking on 311 lipid complexes, while MHPC512 is validated against GROMACS and AmberTools for MD.

ranked.headline: Reference-free and benchmarked inference across genome assembly and phylogenomics
ranked.summary: Reference-free estimation from low-coverage diploid genome skims and fungal assembly benchmarking appear in recent preprints and a new OrthoFinder release.

ranked.headline: Summary-statistic models with annotation, covariate and temporal structure
ranked.summary: Published and preprint work now encodes functional annotations, covariates, and time directly into GWAS-based genetic models.

ranked.headline: Imputed and low-depth genotypes now drive haplotype and structural variant inference
ranked.summary: Imputation and ultra-low-depth sequencing are being used to recover haplotypes and structural variants without deep trio or full-coverage data.

ranked.headline: Reproducible omics tools span QC, RNA modification, spatial integration, and annotation
ranked.summary: Recent tools evaluate omics data without ground truth or reference, extending analysis to spatial, nanopore, and chromatin accessibility datasets.

ranked.headline: Language-model embeddings predict enzyme function, PTMs and disordered binding regions
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and a published tool extend sequence-based prediction of enzyme, modification, and binding annotations from protein and DNA sequence.

ranked.headline: Learned predictors now decide which molecules get encoded, scored, and advanced
ranked.summary: Learned models increasingly gate which compounds are encoded, scored, and advanced, including for combination effects and hepatotoxicity.

ranked.headline: Learned models predict metabolic fluxes from constraint-based network data
ranked.summary: Neural and tree-based models are being trained on constraint-based simulation outputs to deliver fast, interpretable flux predictions.

ranked.headline: Mass spectrometry resolves proteoform-level variation from peptides and intact proteins
ranked.summary: Bottom-up and top-down workflows are now being combined with differential statistics to assign quantitative changes to specific proteoforms.

ranked.headline: Mechanical and reaction-diffusion models link cell-scale dynamics to tissue patterning
ranked.summary: Recent preprints formalize tissue mechanics and morphogen kinetics as time-evolving models linking microscopic rules to collective outcomes.

ranked.headline: Dynamic packing and coupling shape allostery, knot topology, and salt-bridge conservation
ranked.summary: Simulation and family-scale structural analyses now quantify how local structural states and their couplings relate to function in disease and allostery.

ranked.headline: Resources linking missense variants to functional labels, structure, and population data
ranked.summary: Standardized functional labels, structural mapping, and population annotation are now being packaged together in public resources.

ranked.headline: Simulations map gating and conformational transitions in transporters and channels
ranked.summary: Adaptive steered MD, Markov state modelling and multi-scale simulations resolve pathway- and stage-specific conformational switches beyond static snapshots.

ranked.headline: Inferring RNA-mediated regulation from interaction, network, and composition data
ranked.summary: Recent methods couple RNA-DNA interaction, regulatory network, and transcription data to fate, enhancer, and localization readouts.

ranked.headline: Restricted candidate search and domain-level structure drive orthogroup inference
ranked.summary: Orthogroup tools are being redesigned to avoid all-vs-all comparison while matching or exceeding OrthoFinder on accuracy or speed.

ranked.headline: Biology LLM agents are benchmarked and built for epigenomics and peptide design
ranked.summary: Recent preprints benchmark agent performance on epigenomics workflows, dual-use biology tasks, and metabolic model analysis, with best setups passing 45%.

ranked.headline: Harmonized metadata and automated workflows for FAIR reuse of microscopy and omics data
ranked.summary: Multi-centre and national consortia now aggregate microscopy and sequencing data, making explicit, versioned metadata a prerequisite for reuse.

ranked.headline: Bayesian and neural methods infer single-cell lineage trees and early fate decisions
ranked.summary: Sequential CRISPR lineage recordings and transcriptome-based neural models now enable joint inference of lineage trees and early fate bias.

ranked.headline: Interneuron connectivity and M-current shape oscillation regimes and synchrony in…
ranked.summary: Recent June 2026 models link interneuron connectivity and intrinsic currents to oscillation regimes and synchrony in cortical networks.

ranked.headline: Histology-based models infer spatial transcriptomic states beyond measured sparse profiles
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and a MicNet publication couple H&E or multiplexed imaging with spatial transcriptomics to extend molecular readouts across tissue.

ranked.headline: Ortholog loss, horizontal transfer and introgression reshape gene content across lineages
ranked.summary: Genome-scale comparisons now track gene loss, transfer, and introgression as discrete units across fish, eukaryotes, and human populations.

ranked.headline: Quantifying parameter uncertainty to guide model selection and experimental design
ranked.summary: Dynamical models of epidemics, wound healing and lipid metabolism now report parameter constraint explicitly before their parameters are interpreted.

ranked.headline: Computational frameworks for assessing human centromere architecture from genomic data
ranked.summary: Recent preprints offer new ways to score centromere assemblies and infer centromere architecture from short-read data.
